officialApp.name: No official companion app
officialApp.notes: No app. All control is through the inline microphone pod.

battery.chargingIndicators: LED on the inline control pod; micro-USB charging.
battery.notes: Single battery in the cable pod, up to 8 h; about 2 h charge. No case. Headfonia measured roughly 7–7.5 h with aptX HD.

anc.notes: No ANC; relies on the earphone's passive isolation.

features.name: Bluetooth MMCX cable
features.notes: Works with Etymotic ER series and other MMCX earphones.

features.name: AKM AK4331 Velvet Sound DAC/amp
features.notes: Dedicated DAC and amplifier in the cable pod.

features.name: Inline remote
features.notes: Volume, playback, tracks, calls and Google Assistant/Siri.

gestures.action: Volume up; long press next track
gestures.notes: Long-press track skip is documented in reviews rather than the product page.

gestures.action: Volume down; long press previous track

controls.physicalButtons: Inline pod with volume rocker and multifunction button.

audio.notes: No DSP, EQ or app. Sound character comes from the attached ER-series earphone.

featureDeltaFromPrevious: MMCX version of the Etymotion cable for ER2/ER3/ER4 and EVO
Dedicated AKM DAC/amp instead of a codec-integrated output

sources.title: Etymotic manuals page (Etymotion Wireless Bluetooth Manual)
Etymotion review: 8+ h claim and measured 7–7.5 h

gaps: Etymotic's current page omits battery hours and Bluetooth version; 8 h comes from the manual-era spec and secondary reviews.
Exact inline gesture map is not in the current product description.
No multipoint support is documented; assumed absent.
notes: Etymotic EVO and ERX are wired-only. No official Bluetooth EVO/ERX bundle was found, so they are excluded per the scope rule. This cable is the current Etymotic Bluetooth product.
